cohort: Adult and paediatric female patients (aged 8-53 years) with 21-hydroxylase-deficiency congenital adrenal hyperplasia, some of whom had undergone feminising genitoplasty.
finding: Self-reported HRQoL and LUTS were not impaired in CAH patients; however, parents reported significantly lower school and emotional functioning in paediatric patients, and adult patients' sexual function required more attention.
cross-section timing: At a single point in time for adult and paediatric CAH patients.
